g.text: “I place Srrm2 below Thoc1/Prpf6 and well below

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: U2af2/Rnpc3, but slightly above the weaker

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525
font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: Tardbp, and Snrnp70. The point estimate is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525
font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d57a1f
font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525
font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: therefore the modest chromatin and methyl-DNA factors,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: especially Mecp2 at 16 DEGs, Arid1a at 22, and Chd2

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: at 34, with the many zero-count neuronal TFs pulling

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: the estimate down and Sin3a/Chd4 treated as

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: mechanistically too broad. […] Final point prediction:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525
font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d57a1f
font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: “I did not scale the prediction to hundreds of DEGs,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: however, for three reasons. First, the same causal class

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: was muted in the exact focal endpoint: Eef2 gave only

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: 9 focal DEGs, even though EEF2 was much broader in

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: upper-layer cortical neurons in the same experiment.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: […] Prediction: Eef1a2 = 12 DEGs at BH FDR 0.05 in

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525
font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d57a1f
font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: “The better numerical bracket is therefore the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: low-positive chromatin/NDD region represented by Ogt

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: at 4, Crebbp at 8, and Setd5 at 9, with Kmt2a at 24

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #252525

g.text: as an upper edge and Kmt2c at 0 as a null counterexample.
